cpu.desc: CPU allocation in threads. 100% = 1 thread, 200% = 2 threads, 1000% = 10 threads

disk.desc: Disk space allocation in MB (10240 MB = 10 GB)

memory.desc: How much memory in MB to allocate

ip.desc: What IP to bind the server to

port.desc: Port the web server listens on (TCP). It is also passed to the app as the PORT environment variable

gitrepo.desc: HTTPS URL of a git repository to download on install, for example https://github.com/user/my-bot.git. Reinstalling pulls the latest commit. Leave empty to upload the files yourself

gitbranch.desc: Branch to check out. Empty means the default branch of the repository

gittoken.desc: Personal access token for a private repository (GitHub, GitLab). Leave empty for public repositories

createproject.desc: When no git repository is set and the server folder has no Laravel app, the install creates a new one with composer create-project laravel/laravel

migrate.desc: Run php artisan migrate --force before every start

optimize.display: Cache Config and Routes on Start
optimize.desc: Run php artisan optimize (config, events, routes and views caches) before every start. Changes to .env then need a restart

installonstart.desc: Run composer install before every start when there is a composer.json, so packages added to it are picked up

nodev.desc: Install with composer install --no-dev, leaving out require-dev. Only for apps configured for production

workers.desc: PHP processes that answer requests at the same time (PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS). 1 answers one request at a time

phpflags.desc: Extra php.ini settings for the web server, for example -d upload_max_filesize=64M -d post_max_size=64M

commands: bash -c "set -e; if [ -z \"$GIT_REPO\" ]; then exit 0; fi; if ! command -v git >/dev/null 2>&1; then if [ \"$(id -u)\" = 0 ] && command -v apt-get >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo \"Installing git in the install container\"; apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends git ca-certificates >/dev/null; else echo \"git is not installed, it is needed to download the repository\"; exit 1; fi; fi; g() { git -c safe.directory='*' -c init.defaultBranch=main -c advice.detachedHead=false \"$@\"; }; auth=(); if [ -n \"$GIT_TOKEN\" ]; then auth=(-c \"http.extraHeader=Authorization: Basic $(printf 'oauth2:%s' \"$GIT_TOKEN\" | base64 | tr -d '\\n')\"); fi; [ -d .git ] || g init -q; echo \"Fetching $GIT_REPO ${GIT_BRANCH:-(default branch)}\"; g \"${auth[@]}\" fetch -q --depth 1 \"$GIT_REPO\" \"${GIT_BRANCH:-HEAD}\"; g reset -q --hard FETCH_HEAD; echo \"Checked out $(g log -1 --format='%h %s')\""

bash -c "set -e; export COMPOSER_HOME=\"$PWD/.aether/composer\" COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR=\"$PWD/.aether/composer/cache\" COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1; echo \"Creating a new Laravel project\"; rm -rf /tmp/laravel; composer create-project --no-interaction --no-progress --prefer-dist laravel/laravel /tmp/laravel; cp -a /tmp/laravel/. .; rm -rf /tmp/laravel; echo \"Created $(php artisan --version)\""

bash -c "set -e; export COMPOSER_HOME=\"$PWD/.aether/composer\" COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR=\"$PWD/.aether/composer/cache\" COMPOSER_ALLOW_SUPERUSER=1; if [ ! -f artisan ]; then echo \"There is no Laravel app (artisan) in the server folder yet\"; exit 0; fi; if [ -f composer.json ]; then dev=(); if [ \"${nodev}\" = true ]; then dev=(--no-dev); fi; echo \"Installing Composer packages\"; composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader \"${dev[@]}\"; fi; if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -f .env.example ]; then echo \"Creating .env from .env.example\"; cp .env.example .env; fi; if [ -f .env ] && ! grep -Eq '^APP_KEY=.+' .env; then php artisan key:generate --force; fi; if [ -f .env ] && grep -q '^DB_CONNECTION=sqlite' .env && ! grep -q '^DB_DATABASE=' .env && [ -d database ] && [ ! -e database/database.sqlite ]; then echo \"Creating the SQLite database database/database.sqlite\"; touch database/database.sqlite; fi"

run.command: bash -c "set -e; unset GIT_TOKEN; export COMPOSER_HOME=\"$PWD/.aether/composer\" COMPOSER_CACHE_DIR=\"$PWD/.aether/composer/cache\"; if [ ! -f artisan ]; then echo \"Aether Panel: there is no Laravel app (artisan) in the server folder. Upload your app, or set a git repository, and reinstall.\"; exit 0; fi; if [ \"${installonstart}\" = true ]; then if [ -f composer.json ]; then dev=(); if [ \"${nodev}\" = true ]; then dev=(--no-dev); fi; echo \"Installing Composer packages\"; composer install --no-interaction --no-progress --prefer-dist --optimize-autoloader \"${dev[@]}\"; fi; fi; if [ ! -f .env ] && [ -f .env.example ]; then echo \"Creating .env from .env.example\"; cp .env.example .env; fi; if [ -f .env ] && ! grep -Eq '^APP_KEY=.+' .env; then php artisan key:generate --force; fi; if [ -f .env ] && grep -q '^DB_CONNECTION=sqlite' .env && ! grep -q '^DB_DATABASE=' .env && [ -d database ] && [ ! -e database/database.sqlite ]; then echo \"Creating the SQLite database database/database.sqlite\"; touch database/database.sqlite; fi; if [ ! -e public/storage ] && [ ! -L public/storage ] && [ -d storage/app/public ]; then echo \"Linking public/storage to storage/app/public\"; ln -s ../storage/app/public public/storage; fi; if [ \"${migrate}\" = true ]; then php artisan migrate --force; fi; if [ \"${optimize}\" = true ]; then php artisan optimize; elif [ -f bootstrap/cache/config.php ] || [ -f bootstrap/cache/events.php ] || ls bootstrap/cache/routes-*.php >/dev/null 2>&1; then php artisan config:clear; php artisan route:clear; php artisan event:clear; fi; export AETHER_FRONT_CONTROLLER=1; echo \"Serving $(php artisan --version) on port ${port} with ${workers} workers\"; exec php -d memory_limit=${memory}M ${phpflags} -S 0.0.0.0:${port} -t public .aether/router.php"

<?php
// Router for PHP's built-in web server, written by Aether Panel before every start (edits are lost).
// Hidden files and folders (.env, .git, .aether) are never served, nor vendor/ and the Composer
// files when the document root is the project folder. With a framework, files that exist are
// served as they are and every other request goes to the front controller index.php.
$root = rtrim($_SERVER['DOCUMENT_ROOT'], '/');
$path = rawurldecode(parse_url($_SERVER['REQUEST_URI'], PHP_URL_PATH) ?? '/');
if (preg_match('#/\.(?!well-known/)#', $path) || (is_file($root . '/composer.json') && preg_match('#^/(vendor/|composer\.(json|lock)$)#', $path))) {
    http_response_code(404);
    echo "Not Found\n";
    return true;
}
if (getenv('AETHER_FRONT_CONTROLLER') !== '1') {
    return false;
}
$file = $root . $path;
if ($path !== '/' && (is_file($file) || (is_dir($file) && (is_file($file . '/index.php') || is_file($file . '/index.html'))))) {
    return false;
}
$_SERVER['SCRIPT_NAME'] = '/index.php';
$_SERVER['SCRIPT_FILENAME'] = $root . '/index.php';
$_SERVER['PHP_SELF'] = '/index.php';
chdir($root);
require $root . '/index.php';
